About Kino
A NuvioTV fork for Emby libraries
Version %1$s
Kino is a fork of NuvioTV adapted for Emby libraries. The original player and interface are based on the work of the NuvioTV authors.
Genre rows, tolerant title and actor search, local viewing history, and configurable streaming quality. Ratings and metadata come from your server.
